name: Patient Travel Subsidy Scheme (PTSS)
summary: Help with travel and accommodation costs when specialist treatment isn't available within 50km of your nearest public hospital.
key: Private car travel is subsidised at $0.45 per km, and commercial accommodation up to $70 per night.
who: Specialist treatment not available within 50km of your closest public hospital or public health facility
how: Check eligibility with the online Eligibility Checking tool
Complete Form A (Patient Registration) and the banking details form; your doctor helps with Form B
Submit forms to a Queensland public hospital or public health service

source.label: Queensland Health: Patient Travel Subsidy Scheme brochure

evidence.quote: not available within 50km of the patient’s closest public hospital or public health facility.
A rate of $0.45 per km, calculated using a predetermined toll-free route between facilities.
